description: Drag from a source to a target element, or between coordinates (fromX/fromY/toX/toY) for canvas/game aiming. Set via:'cdp' for trusted CDP input; via:'auto' falls back to synthetic. Supports inline post-drag waitMs/waitForSelector/waitForText.

contextId.description: Optional isolated context; context tab IDs are negative

holdMs.description: Hold at destination before release in ms (slingshot pull)

sleepMs.description: Alias for waitMs: milliseconds to sleep after dragging

via.description: Input backend: synthetic (default), cdp (trusted), auto (cdp with synthetic fallback)

waitForSelector.description: Optional CSS selector or @ref to wait for after dragging

waitForText.description: Optional text to wait for on the page after dragging

waitMs.description: Optional milliseconds to wait/sleep after dragging
